# Pillow image conversion notices

FLUKE uses Pillow 12.3.0 under the MIT-CMU License for animated image frame decoding and GIF/WebP encoding. The license text, including bundled component notices from the Pillow wheel, is included in `licenses/MIT-CMU-LICENSE.txt` and in packaged builds under `_internal/licenses/pillow/`.

Pillow is used as a separate Python package. The converter does not import code or assets from flyingmouse-format.

## Upstream

- [Pillow 12.3.0](https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/tree/12.3.0)
